title: Rabbi Abba bar Shumani
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 64a, he and Rav Menashya bar Yirmeyah of Gifti or Difti take leave of each other at the river-crossing of Bana Yofti. They say: “Let each of us state a teaching the other has not heard, for Mari bar Rav Huna said,” etc.

Hyman has already explained in the entry on Rav Menashia bar Yirmeya that he lived approximately in the time of Rav Ashi, contrary to Mishpachot Sofrim, which has Rabbi Abba bar Shumani in the second generation. In Dikdukei Soferim he cites various readings: Rabbah Shimi or Shimni; and in Yuchasin HaShalem he reads Rava bar Shumani.

notes.text: The checked passage describes a river crossing. The Gifti/Difti and Abba/Rabbah/Shimi/Shimni/Rava variants are preserved as reported readings, without identity merger.

The inspected Eruvin 64a directly names Abba bar Shumni and Menashya of Gifti at the crossing of the river Yofti. Hyman’s Bana Yofti, Gifti/Difti alternatives, dating and exact Dikdukei Soferim/Yuchasin readings remain distinct reported claims.
